protocol.target_expression: target = mix - isolated_stem = mix - (raw_stem * normalization_scale); targets[s] in old prep are mute signals, not isolated stems.
protocol.normalization: use each source .pt normalization_scale, shared across mix and all stem-mute variants
protocol.random_baseline_definition: shuffle z_target across windows before subtracting each window z_ref; seed 20260925
